telemetry/hub.go now derives or forwards trace_id and hands best-effort journal events to telemetryaudit/ for Kafka topic pegasus-telemetry-raw plus replay-safe Spanner persistence into DriverTelemetry.

runtimeContracts.name: Telemetry audit journal
consumers: future supplier telemetry audit read models
notes: WebSocket ingress remains JSON for current admin/mobile clients; durability is additive behind the hub.
TraceId accepts both client UUIDs and deterministic SHA-256 hex derived server-side when older clients omit trace_id.

runtimeContracts.name: Legacy infra compatibility surface
notes: Domain compatibility mounts were re-homed to orderroutes, catalogroutes, warehouseroutes, and telemetryroutes.
Debug mint token route ownership moved to authroutes and remains gated by EnableDebugMintToken.

runtimeContracts.name: Retailer role-row surface
consumers: retailer-app-desktop suppliers, analytics, tracking, payment, and saved-card pages
retailer-app-ios retailer order fulfillment tracking settings and realtime flows
retailer-app-android retailer order fulfillment tracking settings and realtime flows
notes: Retailer role-row composition now includes idempotency-guarded legacy procurement create and cancel mutations while shared order list/detail/refund compatibility reads live in orderroutes.
This extracted surface centralizes the shared retailer contract across desktop, iOS, and Android.

Retailer desktop and iOS order-list consumers now target GET /v1/retailers/{retailerID}/orders, and retailer websocket payment handlers accept both PAYMENT_* and GLOBAL_PAYNT_* aliases for settlement/failure continuity.

POST /v1/retailer/cart/sync now emits CART_SYNC_UPDATED over ws/retailer post-commit, and retailer desktop, iOS, and Android cart stores rehydrate from GET /v1/retailer/cart/sync on that signal for cross-device cart convergence.

POST /v1/retailer/orders/{confirm-ai,reject-ai} now emits AI_ORDER_CONFIRMED/AI_ORDER_REJECTED via transactional outbox in the same Orders mutation transaction, and ORDER_REASSIGNED fanout now resolves affected retailer recipients for desktop/iOS/Android refresh parity.

Retailer desktop notification inbox refresh now includes SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED and DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED, iOS/Android inbox icon mappings classify ORDER_REASSIGNED plus settlement/session-update events, and packages/types/ws-events.ts now includes additive retailer ws-event contracts for ORDER_REASSIGNED, SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED, DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED, and CART_SYNC_UPDATED.

Retailer Android push fallback mapping now includes SETTLEMENT_REQUIRED and DELIVERY_SESSION_UPDATED title/body handling in PegasusFirebaseMessagingService so settlement/session-update alerts remain visible while backgrounded or when websocket delivery is unavailable.

runtimeContracts.name: Driver role-row surface
consumers: driverappios APIClient and driver wait-state websocket views
notes: driverroutes now owns the driver websocket route mount that was previously inline in main.go.
Legacy GET /v1/fleet/manifest remains additive for compatibility while clients use GET /v1/driver/manifest.

High-consequence driver mutations (/v1/order/deliver, /v1/order/confirm-offload, /v1/order/complete, /v1/order/collect-cash, /v1/delivery/arrive) now send deterministic Idempotency-Key headers from both Android and iOS clients for replay-safe retries.
Driver availability toggles emit DRIVER_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED inside the same Spanner ReadWriteTransaction via outbox; kafka.EmitNotification remains post-commit best-effort fanout.

Driver login/profile payloads include additive dual-node fields (home_node_type, home_node_id, driver_mode, factory metadata) so one driver app role row can operate both factory-transfer and warehouse-delivery assignments.
/v1/auth/driver/login now supports tenant-safe same-phone disambiguation with optional supplier_id and returns explicit ambiguity when multiple tenant matches share valid credentials.

runtimeContracts.name: Factory role-row surface
consumers: factory-portal dashboard and shell profile hydration
notes: Factory portal shell now hydrates identity from GET /v1/factory/profile instead of static labeling.

Android and iOS clients expose additive advanced-factory endpoint methods (transfers/create, manifests detail/transition, fleet split lists, staff detail) while preserving existing operator-loop behavior.
Factory realtime contract is additive with GET /v1/ws/factory and typed events FACTORY_SUPPLY_REQUEST_UPDATE, FACTORY_TRANSFER_UPDATE, FACTORY_MANIFEST_UPDATE, and FACTORY_OUTBOX_FAILED.
Factory realtime envelopes now include stable trace_id keys for supply request, transfer, manifest, and outbox-failure updates.
Portal, Android, and iOS now subscribe to websocket-triggered reloads, while polling/manual refresh remains fallback.
/v1/auth/factory/login now supports tenant-safe same-phone disambiguation with optional supplier_id/factory_id and returns explicit ambiguity when multiple tenant matches share valid credentials.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier geo-planning surface
consumers: admin-portal supplier homepage coverage alerts cell
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into proximityroutes without changing the delegated proximity handlers.
The portal currently consumes geo-report, dispatch-audits, zone-preview, and validate-coverage; serving-warehouse and warehouse-loads remain supplier-facing backend planning support surfaces.

runtimeContracts.name: Regional config substrate
methods: ALTER TABLE Suppliers ADD COLUMN RegionId
ALTER TABLE Warehouses ADD COLUMN RegionId
ALTER TABLE Retailers ADD COLUMN RegionId
consumers: backend-go unified checkout currency context resolution via countrycfg.Service
supplier and warehouse route composers via auth.RequireRegionScopeWithClient query compatibility enforcement
future supplier and warehouse region-filtered surfaces
notes: Phase-1 rollout is additive and backward-compatible: RegionId links are nullable and country defaults remain valid.
Bootstrap now seeds UZ-DEFAULT region/config rows so runtime region resolution has deterministic fallback behavior.

auth/region_scope.go now provides RegionScope context injection and AppendRegionFilter helpers; supplier and warehouse role-route composers enforce region_id query compatibility for SUPPLIER/ADMIN/WAREHOUSE callers.

Region-scoped SQL helper adoption now covers supplier treasury reads (/v1/treasury/cash-holdings, /v1/supplier/settlement-report), supplier logistics picking-manifest reads (/v1/supplier/picking-manifests*), warehouse ops reads (/v1/warehouse/ops/{dashboard,orders,orders/{id},dispatch/preview,crm,returns,analytics,treasury,financials}), and warehouse demand-forecast order-side reads (/v1/warehouse/demand/forecast) via Retailers.RegionId when region_id scope is active.

runtimeContracts.name: Webhook gateway ingress surface
notes: webhookroutes now composes all gateway ingress routes behind shared priority and logging middleware wrappers.
payment/adyen_webhook.go enforces signature-first per-item HMAC verification and idempotency guards before settlement/failure mutation paths.
Route-level coverage in webhookroutes/routes_test.go verifies mount and middleware wrapping behavior for all webhook paths.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier self-service setup surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into supplierroutes while preserving the existing supplier and vault handlers.
The portal currently consumes billing setup, profile, shift, and payment-config paths as one supplier self-service contract.
Supplier gateway capability metadata now includes ADYEN manual-onboarding fields, and runtime gateway resolution is centralized in payment.NewProviderClient.
The supplier payment-config fallback now dedupes duplicate capability cards by gateway so backend capability payload drift does not render two GLOBAL_PAY setup cards in the portal.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier warehouse-ops surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into supplierroutes while preserving the existing supplier handlers.
POST /v1/supplier/warehouses/{id}/coverage now persists polygon-derived H3 cells through the warehouse spatial outbox and cache refresh path instead of failing as an unwired portal mutation.

Driver and factory staff provisioning now enforce duplicate-phone checks within supplier scope (SupplierId) for POST /v1/supplier/fleet/drivers, POST /v1/warehouse/ops/drivers, POST /v1/factory/staff, and POST /v1/auth/factory/register.

Warehouse-scoped supplier routes now inject auth.RequireWarehouseScopeWithClient(d.Spanner), constraining SupplierRole=FACTORY_ADMIN to warehouses linked through Warehouses.PrimaryFactoryId/SecondaryFactoryId; out-of-scope warehouse_id returns 403 and multi-link scope without explicit warehouse_id returns 400.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier catalog-pricing surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into suppliercatalogroutes while preserving the existing supplier handlers and pricing services.
GET /v1/supplier/pricing/rules remains owned by PricingService.HandleUpsertPricingRule so the supplier pricing page keeps its current list-plus-upsert contract.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier logistics surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into supplierlogisticsroutes while preserving the existing manifest service and supplier dispatch handlers.
Manifest path dispatch is explicitly tested so detail and action suffixes stay aligned with the old inline main.go behavior.
Supplier picking-manifest reads now apply auth.AppendRegionFilter against Retailers.RegionId for scoped region_id requests.

runtimeContracts.name: Payload loading role-row surface
notes: The payload terminal, payload iOS, and payload Android clients share payloader auth, truck or order reads, manifest lifecycle mutations, inbox routes, and the payloader websocket as one role-row contract.
Shared supplier manifest routes and /v1/ws/payloader now admit PAYLOADER alongside SUPPLIER and ADMIN where payload clients already depend on those paths.
SupplierTruckManifests remains the payload-facing manifest lifecycle source, so payload clients stay aligned on DRAFT, LOADING, SEALED, DISPATCHED, and COMPLETED states.
The payloader websocket now emits typed PAYLOAD_SYNC frames with channel SYNC so payload clients can refresh active manifest state without rendering blank notifications.

PAYLOAD_SYNC is emitted atomically on draft creation plus the supplier manifest start-loading, inject-order, seal, and manifest-exception mutation paths so other payload surfaces stay coherent after cross-device or supplier-portal changes.

Missing-items reports are additive-contract compatible for payload clients: `missing_items` remains canonical, `items` alias is accepted, and `source=PAYLOAD_TERMINAL` permits empty-item review flags.

runtimeContracts.name: Simulation harness surface
consumers: internal ADMIN operators and diagnostics tooling
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into simroutes while preserving simulation handler ownership in backend-go/simulation/handler.go.
The extracted composer registers on chi.Router and does not add new DefaultServeMux paths.
Endpoint exposure remains boot-gated by app.Simulation, which is only armed when SIMULATION_ENABLED=true.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier insights surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into supplierinsightsroutes while preserving the existing countrycfg, analytics, and supplier handlers.
Supplier CRM list/detail payloads now include additive retailer email for the supplier portal contact drawer consumer.
Warehouse-scoped analytics routes in this composer now use auth.RequireWarehouseScopeWithClient(d.Spanner), applying FACTORY_ADMIN factory-linked warehouse validation before handler execution.

Supplier country overrides now validate requested payment_gateways against region/country policy plus active supplier credential readiness before persistence, return additive payment_gateway_policy context from /v1/supplier/country-overrides*, and persist OverrideReason/UpdatedBy/UpdatedByType plus AuditLog rows for upsert/delete actions.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier operations surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into supplieroperationsroutes while preserving the existing supplier fleet, returns, reconcile, and order handlers.
POST /v1/supplier/fulfillment/pay keeps the previous error mapping semantics while moving out of main.go.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier planning surface
consumers: admin-portal supplier delivery-zone and map planning surfaces
admin-portal supplier replenishment and territory controls
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into supplierplanningroutes while preserving existing supplier, factory, and proximity handlers.
Supplier factory create/list/detail/profile payloads now persist and return additive h3_index and product_types metadata for the supplier planning consumers.
Supply-lane mutate actions now resolve organisation supplier scope via claims.ResolveSupplierID() and honor PATCH for plain lane updates so planning clients stop hitting success-shaped no-ops.
Replenishment cron startup remains in main.go; only the supplier-facing HTTP planning surface moved into the composer.

runtimeContracts.name: Supplier core surface
notes: Route composition moved out of main.go into suppliercoreroutes while preserving existing order, analytics, and supplier handlers.
Supplier inventory now honors the mounted root PATCH /v1/supplier/inventory contract and returns additive sku_id/product_name aliases on inventory and audit rows for the supplier portal consumer.

ORDER_REASSIGNED now carries additive supplier_id from the reassign producer, dispatcher fanout resolves supplier recipients through payload plus order lookup fallback, and supplier dashboard/orders/fleet pages refresh on ORDER_REASSIGNED hybrid invalidation.
This extraction removes the final inline /v1/supplier/* registrations from backend-go/main.go.

runtimeContracts.name: Warehouse ops compatibility surface
notes: Inventory accepts q and search filters and accepts sku_id or product_id for mutations.
Inventory responses expose both inventory and items collections plus sku_id and product_id aliases.
Staff create accepts an optional pin and returns the effective one-time pin for native client parity.
Vehicle responses expose both max_volume_vu and capacity_vu plus a derived availability status.

Warehouse treasury invoice responses now include additive per-invoice currency and amount_uzs compatibility aliasing so portal, iOS, and Android treasury views can render currency dynamically without breaking legacy amount contracts.
Supplier warehouse aggregate stats now include explicit driver SupplierId predicates alongside warehouse/home-node filters to preserve strict multitenant isolation on derived counts.
Vehicle availability is schema-backed with Vehicles.UnavailableReason and travels across the warehouse portal, iOS, and Android fleet clients.
Warehouse fleet controls now share driver assign/reset and vehicle activate/deactivate mutations across portal, iOS, and Android.
Warehouse dispatch preview excludes inactive vehicles from the available-driver list so vehicle availability mutations affect dispatch eligibility immediately.
Driver list payloads now carry assigned vehicle availability metadata, and dispatch preview publishes both available_drivers and unavailable_drivers so warehouse clients can explain blocked drivers.

Warehouse ops read queries now apply auth.AppendRegionFilter through Retailers joins across dashboard, orders/detail, dispatch preview, CRM, returns, analytics, treasury, and financials when region scope is active.
Warehouse demand forecast order-side quantity and burn-rate reads also apply auth.AppendRegionFilter through Retailers joins when region scope is active.

runtimeContracts.name: Warehouse live websocket surface
notes: Route registration is mounted in warehouseroutes and delegated to ws/warehouse_hub.
Post-commit emitters live in warehouse/supply_requests.go and warehouse/dispatch_lock.go.
Frames include warehouse_id and timestamp for cross-client filtering.
Current live event types are SUPPLY_REQUEST_UPDATE and DISPATCH_LOCK_CHANGE.
Portal, iOS, and Android clients auto-reconnect and surface reconnecting/offline live state instead of silently freezing.

runtimeContracts.name: Warehouse dispatch mutation surface
consumers: warehouse-portal supply-request detail and dispatch-lock pages
notes: Create flow submits demand-forecast-backed warehouse supply requests from dispatch surfaces.
Warehouse clients can cancel supply requests in warehouse-owned states and acquire or release MANUAL_DISPATCH locks through the same contract.
Dispatch control parity now spans portal, iOS, and Android warehouse clients.
Dispatch-lock list/release now enforces warehouse/factory scope from JWT claims and rejects out-of-scope actions with 403.
Dispatch portal and native clients map 403 lock/dispatch responses to explicit restricted-state messaging.

rules.architecture_guard_mcp: for architecture-triggered diffs, codebase-focus changes must be >= context-sync documentation changes
rules.design_system_guard_mcp: for design-triggered diffs, codebase-focus changes must be >= context-sync documentation changes
